lines: Cleveland 27, Pittsburgh 24 on Friday morning Perth time puts the Browns at 3-1 and the Steelers at 2-2. Rodgers threw 3 TD and 2 INT, DK Metcalf had 5 for 115.
Chiefs at Raiders, Mon 5 Oct 4:25 am Perth, both 3-0, Kansas City -4.5 with a 47.5 total. Best game on the board.
Colts and Commanders open Week 4 in London, Sun 4 Oct 9:30 pm Perth, IND -3.5, total 47.5.
Denver at San Francisco, Mon 5 Oct 4:25 am Perth. The 3-0 Niners are only 3-point favourites after escaping Arizona 36-30.
Buffalo is 3-0 and laying 7 to New England at home, total 49.5. Baltimore is -11.5 against winless Tennessee.
Minnesota, also 3-0, is -10.5 against 0-3 Miami with a 38.5 total, the lowest number of the week.

pregame.matchup_read: Two 2-1 teams at Paycor, Mon 5 Oct 1:00 am Perth, CBS. Cincinnati is a 2.5-point home favourite with a 51.5 total. Mostly sunny, 21C, so no weather excuse for either passing game.
storylines: Bengals are coming off a 30-27 loss at Pittsburgh where Burrow went 28/37 for 282 and 3 TD with no picks, and the offence still lost two fumbles.
ESPN's preview headline frames it as Burrow staying unbeaten against Trevor Lawrence whenever their teams have met.
Jacksonville arrives off a 35-6 home win over New England. An ESPN headline asks whether Brian Thomas Jr., targeted once in Week 3, bounces back here.
Cleveland is 3-1 on a W3 run after beating Pittsburgh 27-24, so Cincinnati at 2-1 is already chasing in the North.
watch_for: Ball security. Two fumbles lost in Pittsburgh was the difference in a three-point game.
The run game. Cincinnati managed 83 yards on 18 carries while Pittsburgh ran for 138 on 23.
Third down. The Bengals were 6-12 last week and 2-2 on fourth down, which is a lot of living on the edge.
pregame.the_call: Bengals win but not by the number. Burrow is 3 TD and no picks sharp, yet the run game and the fumbles say this is a one-score game. Take Jacksonville +2.5.

postgame.what_decided_it: Two lost fumbles and no answer for the run. Pittsburgh ran 23 times for 138 yards at 6.0 a carry, won total yards 411 to 352, and Boswell's late kick settled it 30-27.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 28/37, 282 yds, 3 TD, 0 INT. Clean sheet through the air and still a loss.
Ja'Marr Chase: 9 rec, 98 yds, 1 TD. Tee Higgins added 6 rec, 90 yds, 1 TD.
Jaylen Warren: 17 car, 127 yds, plus 3 rec for 49. He set the tone for Pittsburgh.
postgame.division_meaning: Everyone is 2-1. Cincinnati sits third on tiebreak order despite the best point differential at +17, ahead of BAL +14, PIT -7, CLE -17. Only Cincinnati is on a losing streak.
postgame.the_take: Burrow gave you three touchdowns and zero picks and it still went sideways. Two fumbles lost and 138 rushing yards allowed is the whole story. Ben Baby's headline said it: miscues proved costly.
